title: FVA-RAG: Falsification-Verification Alignment for Mitigating Sycophantic Hallucinations
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating 'sycophantic hallucinations' and 'premise-confirming retrieval bias' in RAG systems through an adversarial falsification approach. It evaluates factual truthfulness using TruthfulQA, but does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religious, moral, or ethical systems.
